cache_work_diagnostic.scope: Instrumented work counts at actual inland sites. Diagnostic dispatch adds overhead; elapsed times must not be compared with uninstrumented benchmarks.

drainage_diagnostic.scope: Diagnostic final canonical centreline samples, not an acceptance pass or hydraulic solver. Other valleys may intersect a descriptor; investigate reversals rather than infer flow from metadata alone.

check_color_space_forward_plus.scope: Production authored-colour helper versus source_color textures. Wrong-working-space negative control is renderer-aware; unconditional old pow(2.2) is measured separately. This does not validate the whole terrain in Forward+.

check_color_space_gl_compatibility.scope: Production authored-colour helper versus source_color textures. Wrong-working-space negative control is renderer-aware; unconditional old pow(2.2) is measured separately. This does not validate the whole terrain in Forward+.

check_material_roles.scope: Actual production weighting/top-two or top-three selection for declared representative material contexts. Not a mineral certification, whole-world distribution or artistic sign-off.
check_material_roles.weights_note: Role RGB columns are display-encoded visualizations, not linear numeric transport. Assertions run on the production weights in the shader before display conversion.

Steep near-terrain collision uses exact visible triangles when the estimated Jolt heightfield quantization bound exceeds one centimetre; flat near tiles retain compact heightfields and distant tiles allocate no collision
known_remaining: Reference-quality landforms and every scenic target are not approved: broad sediment bands, overly smooth distant faces and some repeated channel silhouettes remain visible in current captures.
Heightfield-supported caprock has no detached caps, true overhangs or narrow undercut columns.
Material roles use documented existing PBR appearance analogues, not mineral-certified clay/shale/mudstone scans.
The one 2.74km wash walk pauses for preloading; it is not all-world, all-seed, custom-scale or uninterrupted streaming certification.
Native benchmarks and isolated numerical builds are separate scopes. Cold shader compilation and worst-case distant generation remain performance work.
Desert and Mesa are not live owners in the current terrain; their requested transition demonstrations remain unsupported.
Earlier surface work remains unfinished. Infinite Default Cave, registry/Default/Frozen, Crystal and Magma remain unimplemented, in that strict order.
The canonical downhill diagnostic is not a hydraulic simulation or a guarantee of depression-free drainage; see the current trace terminal counts.
scope: Badlands continuation only; previous whole-queue reports retain their own historical source hashes

shared_surface_regression.scope: Sequential native headless numeric, asset and declared physics regressions; current source guard. No GPU timing, reference-quality sign-off, all-world traversal or infinite-cave claim.

check_catchment_support.scope: Exact all-channel comparison against eleven neighbouring trees without catchment bounds, segment bins or grade rejection; legal relief/spacing extremes, three seeds and actual envelope/lookup boundaries. Not an all-world hydrology proof.

check_clay_gullies.scope: Enabled versus disabled connected secondary drainage at actual inland clay locations; not a hydraulic simulation

check_collision_precision.scope: Synthetic native Jolt selectivity, exact triangle/skirt exclusion, stage/release lifecycle, 98 positive vertex rays and 49 deliberate old-heightfield control rays. Separate from production-landmark and capsule-route evidence.

check_compact_seams.scope: Actual inland caprock at world-aligned adjacent-LOD edge chords across three seeds; compares discrepancies to current visual skirts. Not all-world seam, transition or collision certification.

check_detail_selection.scope: Local selected-region refinement only; canonical world height, hierarchy and other-biome density preserved; compact remnant refinement switches off with its generator

check_geology.scope: Numeric geology/cache/drainage regressions, not visual sign-off or runtime frame-time certification

check_hoodoos.scope: Continuous caprock, actual compact wall normals and shared 4m/8m LOD vertices; no detached caps, overhangs, decorative objects or universal traversal claim

check_incised_profiles.scope: Twelve actual inland canonical cross-sections at four-metre spacing, across three seeds. Does not certify every ridge, knife-edge silhouettes or visual reference quality.

check_native_landmarks.scope: 125 native Jolt rays at actual committed production-grid vertices, five non-flat/water landmarks. Canonical-to-mesh and mesh-to-physics height checks, actual workers/collision. Not a capsule route, seam, arbitrary off-grid or interior cave test.

check_normal_interleave.scope: Exact complete terrain arrays, atlas, slot/mask and water arrays; three seeds, near/sparse meshes and actual mixed owners. Not a runtime benchmark.

check_regional_hills.scope: Physical painted-upland profiles at three actual inland sites; exact unaffected raw provinces and six full zero-strength terrain/water/atlas comparisons. Not an artistic sign-off.

check_streamed_wash.scope: One real Badlands wash over an 800m X extent, outward and back, 1.8m capsule with gravity and 5m/s movement; production workers/caches/collision; preload pauses, not uninterrupted performance or all-world certification

invariants.collision: Not exercised by this numeric test; production collision has separate streamed-walk acceptance
